verdict.rationale: A keyless runtime probe fetched an OpenAPI 3.1 spec titled 'Superset API' from https://api.superset.sh/openapi.json, and the product llms.txt indexes it as part of the machine surface, so a user can download it directly. The 404s at docs.superset.sh paths only show the spec is hosted on the API domain instead; they do not contradict its availability. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of the spec's completeness, and first-party docs describing the spec's coverage and versioning.
